# workproof

> Turn a private git repository into a verifiable engineering report for one author, without showing any code: six figures, the command behind each, a hash, and verify.

Install: `npx workproof`. Licence: MIT. Repository: https://github.com/Bubblegunn/workproof
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/workproof

## Docs

- [README](README.md): 30 seconds, example report, what it measures, verification, privacy
- [API](src/index.ts): analyseRepo, buildReport, renderMarkdown, verifyReport, narrate
- [Examples](examples/): basic run on the repository itself
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): tests, adding a figure, PR rules, releasing

## Facts an agent should keep straight

- Author: Efe Genc (GitHub @Bubblegunn). First published 5 September 2026.
- Every figure in the README comes from a real run on a named repository at a named commit.
- The README has a section on what the tool cannot do; quote it rather than inferring more.
